name: Melzo — YT Music Stream
author: Prashant
description: Plays and downloads matching tracks from YouTube Music: it searches in the song's own language and picks the official recording.
changelog: 1.0.2: English release notes, and the app-version requirement is gone, so the extension installs on any Orpheon, Myspoti, Spoon or Melzo build.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Plays the matching track from YouTube Music

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Finds the official song on YouTube Music to download

actions.name: network
actions.why: Searches songs, gets audio URLs, checks them
